description: Return a READ-ONLY unified diff of the platform worktree, plus its --stat summary. Runs 'git diff' (the read-only git surface the GIT-CONTROLLER policy permits) with argv baked server-side: optional ref/commit to diff against, optional repo-root-confined path (rejected if it escapes root), and a staged flag (--cached). NEVER mutates the repo. The diff is size-capped with an explicit truncated marker plus diff_chars_total (the true length). Use to inspect the exact changes before proposing a patch or asking the operator to commit.
embedding_description: Show a read-only unified git diff of the platform repository worktree, with a --stat summary. Optional ref, confined path filter, and staged/--cached mode. Size-bounded with a truncation marker. Use to review the exact line changes before a commit or patch proposal.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Object with 'diff' (bounded unified diff), 'truncated', 'diff_chars_total' (true length before cap), 'stat' (--stat summary).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with the 'stat' summary, then the diff; if 'truncated' is true, note the cap against diff_chars_total and offer to diff a single path.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Running a read-only 'git diff' (optional ref/path, staged flag) over the platform worktree with server-fixed argv.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: RepoPathError: the path filter escaped the repo root or is denylisted. A git error surfaces in the diff output; a clean tree returns an empty diff (not an error).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For RepoPathError: pass a repo-root-relative path. For an unexpected empty diff: check 'staged' (unstaged vs --cached changes) or the 'ref' you diffed against.
